# Vox

> Vox is a general interest news and explanatory journalism site covering politics, technology, culture, science, climate, health, and economics with a focus on context and analysis.

Vox provides in-depth explainers, breaking news analysis, and long-form journalism across major topic areas including US politics, emerging technologies like AI, and global issues. The site offers multiple content formats including articles, videos, podcasts, and newsletters to reach diverse audiences.

## Key Topics

- Politics & Government
- Trump Administration
- Technology & AI
- Climate Change
- Health & Science
- Personal Finance
- Culture & Media
- Iran War
- Mental Health
- Effective Altruism
- News Explainers
- Podcasts
- Innovation
- Current Events
- Future Perfect

## News & Politics

- [US Politics | Vox](https://www.vox.com/politics): In-depth analysis of US politics, Trump administration, voting rights, Supreme Court.
- [Donald Trump | Vox](https://www.vox.com/donald-trump): Comprehensive coverage of Trump's presidency, policies, Iran war, investigations.
- [The US-Iran war, explained | Vox](https://www.vox.com/politics/481087/us-iran-trump-war-israel-politics-explainer): Explainer on US-Iran conflict, Trump military intervention, Middle East tensions.

## Explainers & Analysis

- [Explainers | Vox](https://www.vox.com/explainers): Hub for Vox's explainer articles providing context on complex news topics.

## Topic Sections

- [Technology | Vox](https://www.vox.com/technology): Tech news covering AI, ChatGPT, OpenAI, tech policy, cybersecurity, innovation.
- [Science | Vox](https://www.vox.com/science): Science news on genetics, disease, psychology, neuroscience, space, climate.
- [Climate | Vox](https://www.vox.com/climate): Climate change, renewable energy, conservation, environmental issues coverage.
- [Health | Vox](https://www.vox.com/health): Health coverage including personal health, public health, mental health, vaccines.
- [Money, Business & Economy | Vox](https://www.vox.com/money): Business, economics, personal finance, labor market, wealth inequality coverage.
- [Culture | Vox](https://www.vox.com/culture): Coverage of books, TV, movies, celebrities, awards, and cultural moments.
- [Life | Vox](https://www.vox.com/life): Lifestyle coverage on religion, love, family, careers, relationships, LGBTQ.
- [Future Perfect | Vox](https://www.vox.com/future-perfect): Impact journalism on global development, philanthropy, effective altruism, solutions.

## Audio, Video & Advice

- [Podcasts | Vox](https://www.vox.com/podcasts): Directory of Vox podcasts including Today Explained and philosophy/culture shows.
- [Video | Vox](https://www.vox.com/videos): Video content hub explaining news, politics, design, history on YouTube and TikTok.
- [Advice | Vox](https://www.vox.com/advice): Guidance on personal finance, mental health, relationships, careers, and self-improvement.
